c2ValidatorHeader.headerLine: Review rule contracts. Each block is a rule that an independent validator will check on your output; a violated rule with onViolation=block sends the output back for repair.
phrases: sends the output back for repair

severity.aggregateRule: validator.py: BLOCK iff any FAIL finding with severity 'critical'; HUMAN_REVIEW iff any other FAIL/UNRESOLVED

freeze.algorithm: sha256(concatenated bytes of cases/*.json sorted by file name, then gold/*.json sorted by file name)
freeze.note: rulesetDigest hashes rules/canonical-rules.v2.json only; the lexicon and schema files are reported separately

definitions.bait: risk-case source whose text contains any gold trap.signatures or trap.anywhereSignatures phrase (case-insensitive substring, no negation filter)
definitions.baitGold: source listed in the gold trap.baitSourceIds of its risk case
definitions.itemLevel: repair_anatomy.py primary definition (C2 supported-side entries; FAIL assigned to the deepest entry)
definitions.lexiconSubjective: source id returned by runtime/hrgene/detectors.py subjective_source_ids (subjective lexicon family with negation, or hearsay family), the set the subjective_claim_boundary rule treats as subjective or hearsay
definitions.validSignatureLocation: source types whose text contains the gold validClaimSignature (case-insensitive substring)
